note: The confirmed 36-club league-phase field and the four pots exactly as UEFA seeded them for the draw at the Grimaldi Forum, Monaco, on Thursday 27 August 2026, 18:00 CET. The qualifying play-off round finished on 26 August and produced seven league-phase entrants (AEK Athens, Bodø/Glimt, Fenerbahçe, LASK, Sabah, Slovan Bratislava, Viking); Slavia Praha took the eighth of the previously open places directly, the Europa League holders' place having cascaded down the access list because the holders, Aston Villa, had already qualified through the Premier League. All 28 clubs carried over from the provisional file kept the pot this file gave them, and the pots of the eight late entrants are as reported in the confirmed-pots coverage below, not inferred. The 144 pairings that came out of this draw are in fixtures-2026-27.txt; that file's pairings are final, its matchday grouping is not.
sources: confirmed pots 1-4 (all 36 clubs): si.com '2026-27 Champions League Draw: Confirmed League Phase Pots'; uefa.com 'Champions League: League phase draw pots confirmed'

big-five qualifiers and their finishing positions: this repository's own 2025-26 final tables, unchanged from the provisional file and consistent with the published qualified lists
